readOnlyChecks.note: These are direct HTTP/source observations only; no UI save/reopen or browser runtime result is claimed.

cases.consoleAction: Open Posts > t5-plugins-c, expand Stellar 2 原文配置, preserve the complete existing stellar_config JSON, and change only render.math to katex. Save the post, reopen it, and confirm the full configuration still contains render.math=katex before opening /post/t5-plugins-c.
assertions: Public inline and display formulas render as KaTeX DOM.
The public page includes /assets/css/main-katex.css and the configured KaTeX stylesheet.
The page manifest has no mathjax extension for this page.

cases.consoleAction: On the same post, keep the site's theme-level math provider disabled, change only stellar_config.render.math to false in Stellar 2 原文配置, then save, reopen, and reload /post/t5-plugins-c.
assertions: KaTeX DOM and KaTeX page stylesheet are absent.
With the theme-level math provider disabled, the original formula source remains visible or safely unrendered.

cases.consoleAction: In Settings > Stellar 2, first GET and retain the complete settings document. Merge the shown theme patch into theme.features.card_hover, preserving version, all other theme fields, and blog_extensions; run Validate, PUT the full document, GET it again, and inspect the homepage. Repeat with the off patch.
assertionsOn: Reopened settings retain both true values.
Manifest card-hover config has spotlight=true and tilt=true.
Homepage cards load the card-hover runtime and corresponding optional CSS; pointer movement adds ready/active state and tilt variables.
assertionsOff: Reopened settings retain both false values.
Manifest has no card-hover extension and optional card-hover CSS is absent.
Card markup may retain card-hover classes, but no runtime active state or inline tilt variables are added.

cases.consoleAction: In Settings > Stellar 2, GET and retain the complete settings document. Merge the shown theme.features.reveal patch while preserving all other fields; run Validate, PUT the full document, GET it again, and reload the homepage for each state.
assertionsOn: Reopened settings retain enabled=true and numeric parameters.
Manifest has a reveal extension scoped to .slide-up with the configured values.
With reduced motion disabled and IntersectionObserver available, offscreen slide-up content is initially hidden and restored/animated when it enters view.
assertionsOff: Manifest has no reveal extension; slide-up content stays visible without the reveal mount.

cases.consoleAction: Use a post containing a real image with the [data-fancybox] carrier. For each state, GET the complete Settings > Stellar 2 document, merge the shown theme.features.lightbox patch, Validate, PUT the full document, and GET again. For failure, keep it enabled and set js/css to same-origin missing paths on the isolated server.
assertions: Enabled: the reopened setting is true, manifest contains lightbox, and clicking the image opens Fancybox.
Disabled: the reopened setting is false, manifest omits lightbox, and clicking does not open a lightbox.

Failure: both configured same-origin assets return 404. A document listener for stellar:extension-error receives detail.id=lightbox and detail.phase=mount, and the browser console reports the failure; ordinary links remain usable.

cases.consoleAction: Open a post body with the official {% swiper %} shortcode and at least two local images. Save it, reopen the post, and confirm the body is retained. To verify no-carrier behavior, remove only the shortcode, save/reopen, and reload. For resource failure, restore the shortcode and use the full Settings > Stellar 2 document flow to set features.swiper.js/css to same-origin missing paths.
cases.schemaBoundary: Strict V2 has no features.swiper.enabled field. The extension is in the manifest unconditionally and mounts only when #swiper-api exists; absence of the shortcode is the no-carrier case, not a persisted settings toggle.
assertions: With the shortcode carrier and valid assets, #swiper-api becomes initialized and navigation/pagination respond.
Without the shortcode carrier, no Swiper instance is created even though the generic manifest entry remains.

With same-origin 404 assets, a document listener for stellar:extension-error receives detail.id=swiper and detail.phase=mount, and the browser console reports the failure; ordinary links still navigate.

cases.consoleAction: Open the existing homepage, which currently contains #pin-slider and [data-text-adaptive]. Confirm runtime behavior and then navigate away/back to verify lifecycle cleanup and remount.
cases.schemaBoundary: Strict V2 defines no pin-slider enable switch and no adaptive-text enabled switch. Pin slider mounts only when .pin-slider exists. Adaptive text always registers and mounts only for [data-text-adaptive] carriers.
assertions: Pin slider changes active slide through its navigation/dots and preserves its configured interval behavior.
Adaptive text loads its registered assets and applies computed text treatment to the existing homepage carrier.
After navigation, removed page nodes have no retained plugin-owned elements, observers, or listeners; returning remounts against current DOM.

captureRequirements.failureObserver: Before loading each failure case, attach document.addEventListener('stellar:extension-error', event => record(event.detail)); verify the expected extension id and mount phase. The runtime also emits a console.error. There is no Console error panel for these browser runtime failures.
